atten4.ptxt: When reusing the belt, inspect the entire circumference of the ribs and back for wear and cracks, and replace it if wear or cracks reach the core (1 or more places) or if the rib rubber is chipped (1 or more places).

s2.ptxt: Using SST, slowly turn the V-belt tensioner clockwise and install the V-belt.

item.ptxt: Check that the SST and tools are securely set.
When compressing the V-belt tensioner, slowly apply force perpendicular to the tool, taking 3 seconds or more.

s2.ptxt: Check that the belt is fitted on each pulley.
Check that the belt is correctly set on each pulley.
Start the engine and check that the belt rotates smoothly with no abnormal noise.
Install the radiator upper air deflector with the 8 clips.

s2.ptxt: Install the engine under cover rear RH with the 5 clips.
